Test Case Description: Verify rate limiting prevents abuse by triggering throttling after repeated reset requests
PreRequisites:
- User has same email address
- Rate limit threshold: 5 requests per 15 minutes
- Forgot password page is accessible
Test Case Expected Result: System enforces rate limiting. After threshold is exceeded, further requests are blocked with error message.

Step Expected Result:
- Error message: 'Bạn đã yêu cầu quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau 15 phút'
- 6th request is blocked (no email sent)
- User cannot submit more requests until cooldown period expires
- Counter resets after 15 minutes
- Prevents spam and abuse
